lines: changelog.yaml is not read by the App Store, which takes the changelog from CHANGELOG.md alone.
Nothing to change where CHANGELOG.md carries the releases; otherwise the App Store shows none of them.
The App Store finds the section for 0.7.2 in 1 changelog.
